== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will only use this skill on attacking foes.

== Notes ==
* This skill is more powerful in [[hard mode]] as it benefits from the increased [[attack speed]] and decreased [[activation time]] of foes.
** In Normal Mode, you can use [[Reckless Haste]] to increase the foe's attack speed.
* [[Arcane Echo]] can be used to help facilitate this strategy by duplicating the skill.
* Capturing this skill from [[Harvest Soulreign]] in the mission [[Against the Charr]] is fairly difficult as a [[cinematic]] will start shortly after he is killed, and his corpse will be removed immediately afterwards. It is however possible to do so by killing [[Gordam Griefgiver]] first, starting activating Signet of Capture when Soulreign is nearly dead, and with quick reflexes capture Spiteful Spirit before the cinematic starts.
